# Fitness Mentors

> Fitness Mentors provides NCCA-accredited online personal trainer certifications, nutrition coaching credentials, and business training for independent fitness professionals.

Fitness Mentors specializes in 100% online certification programs including CPT, COPT, CNS, VGFI, and VHC credentials, along with continuing education courses and coaching templates designed to help trainers build remote fitness businesses.

## Key Topics

- Certified Personal Trainer (CPT)
- Certified Online Personal Trainer (COPT)
- Certified Nutrition Specialist (CNS)
- Certified Virtual Group Fitness Instructor (VGFI)
- Certified Virtual Health Coach (VHC)
- Personal trainer certification
- Online training
- Certification bundles
- Program design
- Nutrition coaching
- Continuing education (CEU)
- Fitness business training
- Virtual coaching
- Corrective exercise
- NCCA accreditation

- [Virtual Health Coach Training Bundle | Fitness Mentors](https://www.fitnessmentors.com/virtual-health-coach-training-bundle): Dual certification bundle in health coaching and COPT for telehealth professionals
